findings.current: All he could do was stand frozen like a stone statue and stare helplessly at the death drawing closer by the second.
findings.defect: The draft changes Mr. Park from sitting in the driver's seat to standing.
findings.rationale: Mr. Park remains seated in the driver's seat until Jin Taekyung rescues him; the source only says that he is frozen stiff, not that he stands.
findings.replacement: All he could do was sit frozen like a stone statue and stare helplessly at death as it drew closer by the second.
findings.source: 그저 석상처럼 굳은 채 시시각각 다가오는 죽음을 빤히 바라보고만 있어야 한다는 사실이 원통할 따름이다.

findings.current: The metal frame crumpled like paper, and shattered glass flew in every direction.
findings.defect: The draft changes sheet metal into the vehicle's structural frame.
findings.rationale: 철판 specifically denotes sheet metal or a steel plate, not the vehicle's frame.
findings.replacement: The sheet metal crumpled like paper, and shattered glass flew in every direction.
findings.source: 철판이 종잇장처럼 우그러지고 박살 난 유리 파편이 사방으로 비산한다.

findings.current: I ran across the roofs of cars, stepping over the heads of people sprinting away for their lives. A System notification rang in my ears.
findings.defect: The draft says Taekyung steps over the fleeing people's heads, whereas the source says he avoids the people while advancing over the car roofs.
findings.rationale: 피해 means that he moves around or avoids the fleeing people; it does not describe stepping over their heads.
findings.replacement: Avoiding the people sprinting back the way they had come for dear life, I advanced across the roofs of the cars. A System notification rang in my ears.
findings.source: 죽을힘을 다해 뒤돌아 뛰는 사람들을 피해 차 지붕을 밟으며 나아가는 내 귓가로 시스템 알림이 울렸다.

findings.current: - A sudden Quest, **[Gate Suppression]**, has been created.
findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around the Quest name, contrary to the required System-panel format.
findings.rationale: The System blockquote already identifies the text as UI content, and the binding Markdown rules prohibit enclosing System UI terms in square brackets.
findings.replacement: - A sudden Quest, **Gate Suppression**, has been created.

findings.defect: The Quest title is unnecessarily enclosed in square brackets.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rules prohibit square brackets around UI terms.

findings.current: B-rank Hunter Hwang Cheol Soo was sweating cold.
findings.defect: “Was sweating cold” is an unnatural English rendering of the idiom 식은땀이 흐르다.
findings.rationale: The source describes a cold sweat caused by fear; “broke out in a cold sweat” is the natural English expression.
findings.replacement: B-rank Hunter Hwang Cheol Soo broke out in a cold sweat.

findings.current: Gates that had once appeared only one or two at a time every year or two had already reached their fourth appearance in the country this year.
findings.defect: “One or two at a time” implies that multiple Gates appeared together in each occurrence, altering the source's frequency statement.
findings.rationale: The source says that only one or two Gates were generated over each one-to-two-year period, not that one or two appeared simultaneously.
findings.replacement: Gates had once appeared only once or twice every year or two, but this was already the fourth one in the country this year.
findings.source: 1, 2년에 한두 개씩 생성되던 게이트가 올해 국내에서만 벌써 네 번째다.

findings.current: They had already been at an overwhelming disadvantage against three times their number.
findings.defect: The numerical advantage is reversed: the draft gives the ogres three times the Hunters' number, while the source says the Hunters had nearly three times as many combatants and were still overwhelmed.
findings.rationale: 세 배에 달하는 인원으로도 identifies the Hunters' own nearly threefold numerical advantage.
findings.replacement: They had already been overwhelmingly outmatched despite having nearly three times as many fighters.
findings.source: 세 배에 달하는 인원으로도 압도적인 열세를 겪어야 했던 그들이다.

findings.current: It tore through leather, flesh, tongue, and the roof of the mouth in succession before jutting out through the top of the ogre’s head.
findings.defect: “Leather” describes processed material rather than the ogre's hide.
findings.rationale: 가죽 here refers to the monster's skin or hide, not manufactured leather.
findings.replacement: It tore through hide, flesh, tongue, and the roof of the mouth in succession before jutting out through the top of the ogre’s head.
findings.source: 가죽, 속살, 혓바닥과 입천장을 차례대로 뚫고 정수리로 삐져나왔다.

findings.current: There was a big difference between opening an acupoint and opening a vessel.
findings.defect: The draft invents an acupoint-versus-vessel distinction and loses the source's wordplay between two kinds of “opening.”
findings.rationale: 타통 and 개통 contrast closely related senses of opening or clearing a passage; the source does not contrast an acupoint with a vessel.
findings.replacement: There was a world of difference between clearing a pathway and opening one up.
